        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM trans AS t
JOIN cohort_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 4000
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ';

WITH markets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ca.type AS card_type,
        cl.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
    WHERE ca.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        card_type,
        district,
        inhabitants,
        MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM markets
)
SELECT card_type, district, inhabitants
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants
ORDER BY
    CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END,
    district;

WITH withdrawal AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        1.0 * w.total_withdrawn / CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS withdrawal_per_inhabitant,
        1.0 * COALESCE(s.total_standing, 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS standing_order_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawal AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN standing AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4, w.total_withdrawn, s.total_standing
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawal_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawal_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ROUND(standing_order_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM metrics
ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant, district_name;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN operation IN ('PREVOD Z UCTU', 'PREVOD NA UCET')
                 AND bank IS NOT NULL
                 AND account IS NOT NULL
            THEN bank || ':' || account
        END) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    ga.account_id,
    di.A2 AS district_name,
    di.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) DESC
    ) AS rank
FROM gold_accounts ga
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON lc.account_id = ga.account_id
ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, ga.account_id;

WITH cohort_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1980 THEN 'young cohort'
            WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 1919 THEN 'old cohort'
        END AS cohort,
        a.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) >= 1980
       OR CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 1919
)
SELECT
    cohort,
    ROUND(AVG(d.A11)) AS average_salary
FROM cohort_accounts AS ca
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ca.district_id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY CASE cohort WHEN 'young cohort' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH winner_laps AS (
    SELECT raceId, MAX(laps) AS laps
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
    GROUP BY raceId
),
japanese_entries AS (
    SELECT r.laps, w.laps AS winner_laps
    FROM results AS r
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN winner_laps AS w ON w.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
      AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN laps = winner_laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM japanese_entries;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(l.milliseconds) ASC, full_name ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.url,
    d.dob,
    COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
   AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
   AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1995
      AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
),
slowest AS (
    SELECT MAX(q1) AS q1
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM race)
      AND q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q1 <> ''
)
SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob, q.q1
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN race AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q1 = (SELECT q1 FROM slowest);

WITH q1_times AS (
    SELECT
        q.q1,
        CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
        + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000.0 AS seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(q.q1) <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(q.q1) <> ''
  AND (
      CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000.0
  ) = (SELECT MAX(seconds) FROM q1_times);

WITH lucas AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.position
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2010
      AND d.forename = 'Lucas'
      AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
      AND q.position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT other.driverId)
FROM lucas AS l
JOIN qualifying AS other
  ON other.raceId = l.raceId
 AND other.position > l.position;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> '\N'
  AND q.q2 < '1:40.000';

SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(q.q3_count), 0) * 1.0 / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS average_q3_lap_times_per_driver
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS q3_count
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q3) <> ''
    GROUP BY driverId
) AS q
    ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1981-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1992-01-01';

SELECT d.code, q.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT d.number AS permanent_career_race_number, d.surname
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, -3) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
  ) < 98.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT res.driverId) AS withdrew_drivers
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1962
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount END) * 1.0 /
    MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount END) AS ratio
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
  AND e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');

WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS spending_budget_ratio
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name
FROM event_ratios
WHERE spending_budget_ratio = (
    SELECT MAX(spending_budget_ratio)
    FROM event_ratios
);

WITH department_majors AS (
    SELECT
        department,
        major_id,
        major_name
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
       OR department IN (
            SELECT department
            FROM major
            WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
       )
),
department_summary AS (
    SELECT
        department,
        GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
        COUNT(*) AS major_count
    FROM department_majors
    GROUP BY department
),
major_members AS (
    SELECT
        dm.department,
        dm.major_id,
        dm.major_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count
    FROM department_majors dm
    LEFT JOIN member m ON m.link_to_major = dm.major_id
    GROUP BY dm.department, dm.major_id, dm.major_name
)
SELECT
    ds.department,
    ds.majors_offered,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        CASE WHEN mm.member_count > 0 THEN mm.major_name END,
        ', '
    ) AS majors_held,
    ROUND(SUM(mm.member_count) * 1.0 / ds.major_count, 2) AS average_members_per_major
FROM department_summary ds
JOIN major_members mm ON mm.department = ds.department
GROUP BY ds.department, ds.majors_offered, ds.major_count
ORDER BY ds.department;

WITH yearly_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, type
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date >= '2019-01-01'
      AND event_date < '2020-01-01'
),
attendance_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS members_attended
    FROM yearly_events e
    JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
),
budget_by_type AS (
    SELECT e.type, SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget
    FROM yearly_events e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT e.type AS event_type,
       COALESCE(a.members_attended, 0) AS members_attended,
       COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget_dollars
FROM yearly_events e
LEFT JOIN attendance_by_type a ON a.type = e.type
LEFT JOIN budget_by_type b ON b.type = e.type
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

SELECT SUM(i.amount)
FROM income AS i
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
  AND i.link_to_member IN (
      SELECT a.link_to_member
      FROM attendance AS a
      JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
      WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  );

WITH event_lines AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        MAX(b.amount) AS largest_line
    FROM event AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM expense AS x
        WHERE x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
          AND LOWER(x.expense_description) LIKE '%chip%'
          AND x.cost > 0
    )
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name
FROM event_lines
WHERE largest_line = (SELECT MAX(largest_line) FROM event_lines);

WITH RECURSIVE food_items(expense_id, rest, item) AS (
    SELECT e.expense_id, e.expense_description || ',', ''
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(b.category)) = 'food'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT expense_id,
           SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1),
           TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, ',') - 1))
    FROM food_items
    WHERE rest <> ''
),
item_counts AS (
    SELECT TRIM(item) AS item_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) AS record_count
    FROM food_items
    WHERE item <> ''
    GROUP BY TRIM(item)
)
SELECT item_name, record_count
FROM item_counts
ORDER BY record_count DESC, item_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND s.full_name <> '-';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM hero_power AS d_hp
            JOIN superhero AS d ON d.id = d_hp.hero_id
            JOIN publisher AS d_pub ON d_pub.id = d.publisher_id
            WHERE d_pub.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
              AND d_hp.power_id = hp.power_id
        )
  );

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad')
   OR a.alignment IS NULL;

WITH hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS listed_power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT g.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
JOIN hero_power_counts AS hpc ON hpc.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND c.colour = 'Blue'
  AND hpc.listed_power_count >= 10
GROUP BY g.gender;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.power_count, 0)), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS p ON p.hero_id = s.id
WHERE r.race = 'God / Eternal'
  AND g.gender = 'Male';

SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
WHERE s.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
)
  AND r.race IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(r.race) <> ''
  AND r.race <> '-'
GROUP BY r.id, r.race
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(race_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count
        FROM superhero AS s2
        JOIN race AS r2 ON r2.id = s2.race_id
        WHERE s2.publisher_id = (
            SELECT publisher_id
            FROM superhero
            WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
        )
          AND r2.race IS NOT NULL
          AND TRIM(r2.race) <> ''
          AND r2.race <> '-'
        GROUP BY r2.id, r2.race
    )
);

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS different_superpowers
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.gender_id = 1
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg < 70;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
LEFT JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE r.race = 'Human'
  AND s.height_cm > 0
  AND s.height_cm = (
      SELECT MIN(s2.height_cm)
      FROM superhero AS s2
      JOIN race AS r2 ON r2.id = s2.race_id
      WHERE r2.race = 'Human'
        AND s2.height_cm > 0
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) = 'neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5);

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.GLU >= 180
      AND l."T-CHO" < 250
);

SELECT p.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
       - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
    2
) AS female_percentage
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Birthday < date('2026-10-09', '-56 years')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PT >= 14
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP LIKE '%+%'
  AND (p.Description IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(p.Description AS TEXT)) = '');

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.Date,
        CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) AS anti_dna_level
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND p.Admission = '+'
      AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.DNA) <> ''
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        anti_dna_level,
        MAX(anti_dna_level) OVER (PARTITION BY ID) AS max_level
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT ID, Date, anti_dna_level
FROM ranked
WHERE anti_dna_level = max_level
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_rnp_value
FROM Laboratory
WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(RNP) <> ''
  AND RNP <> 'negative';

SELECT SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB < 3.5
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

WITH female_thrombosis_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
      AND e.Thrombosis > 0
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT c.ID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) > 64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS elevated
    FROM female_thrombosis_cohort AS c
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = c.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT ROUND(
           100.0 * SUM(elevated) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
           2
       ) AS percentage
FROM patient_results;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS age_years
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 600
  AND l.LDH < 800
  AND CASE
        WHEN lower(l."U-PRO") LIKE 'at least %'
          THEN CAST(trim(substr(lower(l."U-PRO"), 10)) AS REAL)
        WHEN l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
          THEN CAST(substr(l."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL)
        WHEN l."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*'
          THEN CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL)
        ELSE NULL
      END >= 300
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT AVG(HCT) AS average_hematocrit
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date >= '1991-01-01'
  AND Date < '1992-01-01'
  AND HCT IS NOT NULL
  AND ("U-PRO" = '300' OR "U-PRO" = '>=300');

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.CPK < 250
      AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 4
  );

SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH >= 500
)
AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('+2(100)', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')
       OR "U-PRO" GLOB '+*[0-9]*([1-9][0-9]*)'
)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_female_patients
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND "First Date" >= '1998-01-01'
  AND "First Date" < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%';

SELECT e.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
  AND instr(',' || replace(e.Diagnosis, ', ', ',') || ',', ',SLE,') > 0
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(e.Symptoms) <> ''
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC, p.ID ASC, e.`Examination Date` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' END AS sex,
    COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.GPT >= 60
  )
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RBC IS NOT NULL
        AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  )
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE a.element IN ('p', 'n')
GROUP BY b.bond_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
);

WITH molecule_groups AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(b.bond_id) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type <> '-' OR b.bond_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
      THEN 'all_single'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS saturation_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT
  saturation_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM molecule_groups
GROUP BY saturation_group
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN a2.atom_id ELSE a.atom_id END) AS atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a.element = 'cl' AND a2.element <> 'cl')
   OR (a2.element = 'cl' AND a.element <> 'cl');

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element IN (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
  )
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id;

SELECT ROUND(2.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id), 2) AS average_bonds_per_atom
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397';

SELECT
  b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN c.atom_id < c.atom_id2
      THEN a.element || '|' || a2.element
    ELSE a2.element || '|' || a.element
  END) AS element_pair_count,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
LEFT JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
LEFT JOIN atom AS a2
  ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind_symbol ASC;
